text:
platform-ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: API Gateway (apigw-us-east-1) 502/504 error rate spike detected. 18% errors over baseline in last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Threshold breached: gateway-5xx-high. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/apigw/errors

sre-oncall: acked — I'm joining. Anyone see a recent deploy?

marie: i'm on dashboards, queries show spike started ~14:12 UTC. There was an ingress-proxy config roll 16m ago from infra-eng user.

platform-ops-bot: deployment event: ingress-proxy v2.4.7 applied at 1768887900 by infra-eng.

sam: quick check: backend auth-service 95p latency shot to ~10s around same time, many upstream timeouts -> 504. Also a subset of requests return 502 from mux layer.

jordan: can someone paste a failing curl? trying to reproduce from my laptop.

sam: reproduced from jumpbox:
```
$ curl -i -H "Host: api.redwood.example" https://apigw-us-east-1.prod/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\nServer: redwood-gateway\nDate: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 16:20:05 GMT\nContent-Type: text/plain\nContent-Length: 11\n\nBad Gateway
```

support-lead: PS — support queue shows 9 tickets in last 10m, 4 from AcmeCorp (mobile app requests failing). Escalating to CSM.

marie: likely cascade: ingress change + client retry storm + auth-service slowdown. Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle client retries at edge, 2) roll back ingress buffer/timeout change, 3) scale ingress and auth-service pools. I'll apply 1 & 2 now.

infra-eng: scaling ingress pool +2 nodes and bumping auth-service replicas from 6 -> 10. K8s ops in progress.

marie: applying temporary rate-limit on repetitive user-agents (monitor-agent/*) and global short-circuit for heavy-fanout header X-Fanout: true. Patch snippet:
```
kubectl patch cm ingress-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"client_max_retries":"2","proxy_read_timeout":"20s"}}'
```

sre-oncall: rolling back the last ingress-proxy config now (rollback id: ingress-proxy@1768887800). Running: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/ingress-proxy -n infra --to-revision=1768887600`

platform-ops-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-87304 acknowledged by marie at 1768888920.

sam: checking logs, we had a sudden uptick in connection reset from auth upstream:
```
auth-service error: downstream read timeout after 30s, connection reset by peer
```
Could be connection pool exhaustion.

infra-eng: increasing connection pool for auth-proxy and restarting a couple of proxy pods to clear stale connections.

customer-ops: opened private bridge with AcmeCorp CSM and support. They're seeing 502s primarily from mobile region us-east-1. Sharing a short status for customers.

marie: mitigation summary so far: ingress rollback + rate-limit + increase ingress/auth replicas + restart auth-proxy pods. Early telemetry shows error rate dropping from 18% -> 7% in last 3m. Still monitoring.

jordan: i'll take the primary pager in 20m and stay on-call for the next handoff. marie, please hand off to me when you step out.

support-lead: filing interim customer note: "We're investigating elevated 502/504 responses in us-east-1; mitigations applied; next update in 15m."

marie: leaving runbook notes in the incident doc: applied rollback, patched ingress config, applied client retry filter, scaled pods, restarted proxy. tagging logs with incident=INC-87304. Will collect heap/profile traces for auth-service if error rates don't continue down.

platform-ops-bot: metrics update: apigw 5xx now 3.2%, p95 latency back to baseline for most routes.

sre-oncall: verified end-to-end: sample requests now return 200 for endpoints that were failing.

jordan: I have the handoff. marie — handing to jordan in 10m. If anything flares, page me (PD: jordan-oncall).

marie: handing off to jordan — incident unacked -> acknowledged by jordan at 1768889500. Postmortem owner assigned: marie. Will include timeline and root cause hypothesis (ingress config + connection pool exhaustion + client retry amplification).

platform-ops-bot: incident state: mitigated — continue monitoring for 60m. Close when stable and postmortem created.

support-lead: customer update queued. closing support tickets as systems recover.

marie: closing notes: create follow-ups: increase circuit-breaker defaults, add synthetic traffic to catch retry storms, and revise ingress rollout health checks.

platform-ops-bot: incident INC-87304 status changed to MITIGATED at 1768889550.
